title: Can you still download Apple Clips for iPhone?
reader: New iPhone user following an older Apple Clips tutorial
job: Apple says Clips stopped being updated and became unavailable to new users on October 10, 2025. People who downloaded Clips previously can still redownload it through their Apple account, according to Apple’s support guidance.
source: [Apple’s Clips guidance](https://support.apple.com/en-am/123359) supports availability and saving options. The [Vyra App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vyra-ai-video-editor/id6808889012) supports importing supplied footage and generating captions.

title: Does Add a Caption in Photos put subtitles on my video?
reader: Person whose Photos note is missing from the played video
job: The caption field in iPhone Photos is descriptive metadata for finding a photo or video. It does not place timed words into the video picture. To share visible subtitles, add them in a video editor and export a captioned copy.
source: [Apple’s photo-information guide](https://support.apple.com/en-asia/guide/iphone/iph0edb9c18f/27/ios/27) supports the metadata purpose. The [Vyra App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vyra-ai-video-editor/id6808889012) supports generated captions and export.
demand: editorial hypothesis; product facts verified separately
nextAction: Review the task and use the appropriate native or web workflow

title: Can I change captions already burned into a video?
reader: Editor correcting a word after a captioned export
job: Captions burned into a video are part of its image. To change the wording cleanly, return to the editable project or a source recording without those words, correct the caption track and export again.
source: [HandBrake’s subtitle documentation](https://handbrake.fr/docs/en/latest/advanced/subtitles.html) supports the hard-burn versus selectable-track distinction. The [Vyra App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vyra-ai-video-editor/id6808889012) supports caption and timeline editing, not automatic burned-text removal.
demand: editorial hypothesis; product facts verified separately
nextAction: Review the task and use the appropriate native or web workflow

title: Can I import a custom LUT into Vyra on iPhone?
reader: iPhone creator with a custom .cube LUT file
job: Vyra’s current help says custom .cube LUT import is available on the web, not directly in the iPhone or Android app. A LUT added to the project on the web still appears and exports from the iPhone app.
